json_schema.title: grains.delkey
json_schema.description: Remove a grain key and it's value from the minion grains file. Wrapper around grains.delval that performs destructive removal and optionally forces deletion of mapped values

key.ui:title: Key
key.ui:description: The grain key from which to delete the value

force.ui:title: Force
force.ui:description: Force remove the grain even when it is a mapped value. Defaults to False
